name: decider-12b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-12B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 1)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of google/gemma-4-12B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 11.96 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-29. CAVEATS: v1 (the comparison column) is stock gemma-4-12B-it read through the decider readout at different temperatures, so this compares two readouts as much as two models. Loses the public JevBench hard tier (79 vs 81 correct of 111) and its calibration there is worse (ECE 0.147 vs 0.098). Gains elsewhere are stated by the card as 1-5 points. Decision model: excluded from the worth-running ranking by task=decision.

benchmarks.name: fresh 399-item yes/no set, test half (195), chance-corrected Noul score
benchmarks.config: Card 'Measurements' table, v2 71.6 vs v1 58.8; v1 is stock gemma-4-12B-it read through the same decider readout, no training.
